page.metaDescription: Track conference schedules, speaker announcements, ticket releases, and venue updates for industry events and conferences.
page.subtitle: Track conference schedule pages, speaker announcements, ticket-release pages, and venue updates with automated email alerts.
page.intro: Events teams, attendees, and journalists need awareness of conference schedule changes, speaker line-ups, and ticket-release windows. WebMonitor.fyi tracks the conference pages — schedule pages, speaker listings, sponsor pages, ticket sales pages — for the changes that matter (new speakers, schedule shifts, early-bird endings, ticket releases).

setup.title: List the conferences worth tracking
setup.body: Industry-specific conferences, key partner events, competitor speaking slots. Plans include up to 5 monitors on Pro, so pick the events that matter most this cycle.

setup.title: Monitor schedule and speaker pages
setup.body: New session additions, speaker swaps, and time changes all show up on these pages first.

setup.title: Track ticket-release pages
setup.body: Early-bird windows close on specific dates. Sold-out alerts catch sellouts before the conference rebumps the page.

examples: Marketing teams tracking competitor speaking slots
Journalists watching for newsworthy speaker announcements
Attendees waiting for ticket releases and discount windows
page.limits: Event monitoring catches what the conference publishes publicly. Speaker confirmations sometimes happen behind the scenes weeks before the public listing updates — those are outside scope.

faq.a: Yes. Set 30-minute checks (Pro) on the ticket page during a release window. The state change from "available" to "sold out" triggers an alert on the next check.

faq.q: Does this work for academic conferences?
faq.a: Yes. Academic conference schedule pages and call-for-paper deadlines work as monitor URLs.
